setup: An integral of a hyperbolic function is taken, with the bound or the inner coefficient equal to [[a]].

steps.say: The derivative of sinh u is cosh u and the derivative of cosh u is sinh u, so each function is the antiderivative of the other.
A definite integral evaluates the antiderivative at the upper limit and subtracts its value at the lower limit, and an inner coefficient is divided out by the chain rule.
With [[a]] in place the result is the hyperbolic function of [[a]] less its value at the lower limit, or a fraction with denominator [[a]] when the chain rule applies.
